text:
sara_support: urgent handoff from support 1 — Cardea Labs (tenant: cardea-001) hitting 403 on embeddings ingest during onboarding. SSO provisioning also stuck. Customer expects GA decision in 72h. Ticket #78941. Need CS to own comms + short risk plan. :rotating_light:
incbot: Support ticket #78941 logged by sara_support. Severity: high. Linked case: 5543.
sara_support: repro snippet and 403 body below. Minimal repro: 
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"input":"hello"}'
```
Response: {"error":403, "reason":"quota_enforced"}

sara_support: last successful ingest: 1759876200. SAML trace attached in ticket. Debug token: tx_Ab12.
emma_cs: thanks. Quick triage Qs: did onboarding flow try to re-ingest previous dataset? any large batch jobs?
sara_support: they attempted a delta import (10k vectors) via bulk job at 1759876100. Support logs show a routing decision that returned quota response.
mike_ops: seeing routing anomaly in router logs 1: a subset of cardea traffic was routed to the shared quota pool between 1759876158-1759876210. Root cause looks like an env flag flip during release. Tagging infra-release team.
jamal_cs: I'll lead customer comms. Immediate plan: acknowledge within 30m, schedule an enablement call today, and propose a temporary mitigation so they can continue onboarding without full re-ingest. Emma, can you draft a 5-line customer ack?
emma_cs: draft ack: "Thanks for flagging, Cardea. We're actively triaging. We're scheduling a call at 16:00 PST to walk through next steps; temporary ingestion fallback will be enabled shortly to avoid re-upload. ETA for unblock: ~2h. We will follow up with a full root-cause and permanent fix plan." Thoughts?
jamal_cs: good. Send now. I'll include escalation contacts and link the scheduled 16:00 PST invite.
sara_support: Cardea accepted 16:00 PST. They've asked to avoid re-upload.
mike_ops: mitigation ready: reroute embeddings to lightweight model m-small and enable prefix caching for tenant. CLI to apply (ops):
```
redwood-cli tenants update cardea-001 --route-model m-small --prefix-cache on
```
I can apply once comms sent.
jamal_cs: owners and timeline:
- Acknowledge & invite: jamal_cs (now)
- Triage & logs: sara_support + mike_ops (now)
- Apply fallback: mike_ops (apply, monitor)
- Enablement call: jamal_cs host 16:00 PST
- Renewal risk assessment & follow-up: emma_cs (post-call)
Estimated unblock if fallback succeeds: ~90 minutes. Renewal risk: medium until stable for 48h.
incbot: Ticket #78941 updated: 'fallback pending' (awaiting ops change).
mike_ops: applying fallback now. Posting outcome shortly.
deploy_bot: rolling config patch to routing flags (release 2024.11.3) triggered. Patch id: r-20241103-5.
mike_ops: patch applied at 1759876630. Observing ingest success rate climb from 0 to 140 req/min. 403 errors dropped to <1% since 1759876645. :rocket:
jamal_cs: confirmed. I'll run the 16:00 PST enablement and capture notes: actions taken, temporary workaround, recommended next steps (permanent fix, release rollback, or config guardrails).
emma_cs: I'll flag this account for renewal manager: note "onboarding interruption resolved; monitor 48h; outreach if regression". Also adding a small playbook entry for routing-flag rollbacks.
sara_support: will attach support debug logs and the SAML trace to the CS ticket and update #support thread. Thanks team.
jamal_cs: closing loop for now. Post-call follow-up: share meeting notes, include timeline, and propose permanent mitigation ETA in 24h. :white_check_mark:
